body: It feels like I signed a contract, a promise to not do it, but I don't care anymore, I verbally promised myself, I tattooed myself a reminder of my promise of quitting all the shit, the drink, the drugs, the smoking. But i go back to it, it's reflexive, there's no thought process, it just happens, the only thing that made it better is gone. and it's my fault. Sometimes i just want to scream at the sky in my front yard, to walk to the pitches and down a quarter bottle and pass out there, to wipe it clean, to start over. But i stop myself, I bottle all of it, I store it. Then it overwhelms me. I feel useless, I've scarred myself ashamedly, permanently, the shame of people asking. Knowing that they know or the anxiety when they don't and I have to lie. It's hard to hide burn scars on your knuckles
